description.value: Tim Hortons is a Canadian quick-service chain at a prominent Central Avenue location in Grand Forks, serving coffee, baked goods, soups, and breakfast items with both dine-in and drive-through options. For touring cyclists passing through the Boundary Country, it offers a reliable, familiar stop with indoor seating, Wi-Fi, and a full menu from early morning.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Tim Hortons location page at https://locations.timhortons.ca/en/bc/grand-forks/1863-central-ave confirms the business is open at 1863 Central Ave, Grand Forks, BC V0H 1H2 and lists features explicitly: 'Has WiFi', 'Take Out', and 'Dine-In'. The OSM tags corroborate drive_through=yes and takeaway=yes. No bike-specific infrastructure, washroom signage, or water refill policy is mentioned on the website or in OSM tags. The website provides a phone number, (250) 442-0423, which is absent from the OSM record.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides (250) 442-0423 — added from website source.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible business confirmed by the brand's own location page; a useful stop for touring cyclists on Central Avenue in Grand Forks.
